name: horse-saddle
description: Standalone saddle prop, transparent. The complete 339x240 no-white-edge saddle is active; the retired white-edge and notched copies were removed on 2026-10-23, desktop masters remain.

source.note: saddle.png is a 1:1 copy of Desktop\ma-maan-wanzheng.png (no white edge, 339x240). The retired white-edge copy (desktop master 图片_DSs-0202.png) and notched copy (desktop master 小黄鸭的马\ma-maan.png) were deleted at the user's request; only the active piece remains in the pack. HorseCut/RidingCut currently show the saddle baked into public/parts-horse/body.png; this pack has no runtime manifest entry.

staticMount.layer: above the neck (in front of the neck layer), below the head
staticMount.trim: none; the complete saddle is drawn unmodified and covers the neck's end corner
staticMount.note: Reference fit enlarged 1.0414x from the first 2.1281 fit, anchored at the saddle's brown bottom-left, then nudged +8px forward (x 546.2 -> 554.2) so the front edge meets the mane's inner line at its end (both x=1299 on the 2048 canvas). The left curl clears the body; the complete right side covers the neck's end corner (5851px over the neck). The horn highlight lands at ma (697.9,534.9), 7.2px right of ma-cankao's (690.7,534.7), as a result of the requested alignment. No notch, no trim, no sampled fill; the no-white-edge asset removes the light halo along the outline.

images.note: Alpha touches all four edges, so the trimmed image equals the full canvas.
